hooks.name: AI collaboration log

action.prompt:
First, run date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M" in the terminal to get the current local time. Then append an entry to docs/ai-log/session-log.md (create the file and folder if missing). Format:

## [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM] Short title of what happened
- **Prompt:** my most recent prompt, verbatim
- **What Kiro did:** 2–4 sentences
- **Files changed:** list of files created or modified
- **Decisions:** any decision made or alternative rejected, and why (write "None" if none)
- **Open questions:** anything unresolved (write "None" if none)

Only append. Never edit or delete earlier entries. Do not log this logging action itself, and do not change any other files.

hooks.description: Appends a timestamped entry to docs/ai-log/session-log.md after every agent response, capturing my prompt, what Kiro did, files changed, and decisions, so reviewers can follow the development process as it happened.
